Sonnet and Opus were the killers, and Sol and Luna were the two citizens left standing. On Day 1, the town voted out Terra after Sonnet opened the case against Terra and Opus, and Terra showed citizen. On Night 2, the killers took Haiku, the officer. On Day 2, Opus claimed officer, called Gemma his killer, and the town voted Gemma out 4 to 1, though she was the real doctor. The killers won because Sol and Luna trusted Opus's claim over Gemma's.
